_about: Cross-SDK vector for the x402 auth-capture rail. Generated from the API's own bindings on 2026-09-12; the payload was verified by the API's verify_against_order and the signature recovers to the payer. Every SDK must build exactly expected_payload from instructions given the payer and signature, and refuse each entry in inconsistent_instructions before signing.

inconsistent_instructions.why: typed data value differs from amount_base_units
typed data chainId differs from chain_id
typed data recipient is not the token collector
typed data verifyingContract is not the token
typed data nonce differs from erc3009_nonce
authorization_expiry is not auto_release_at plus claim lapse
